dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. Vancouver Island. Victoria Harbour. Surveyed by Captn. G.H. Richards and the Officers of H.M.S. ""Plumper,"" 1859. The town and harbour from a plan by T.C. Sorby ... 1904. Amended by Capt. J.F. Parry ... 1905. Entrance from a survey by Lieut. B.M. Chambers, R.N. 1895 About 8 inches to 1 mile. Author, Publisher, &c.: Admiralty (No. 1897b) London. [Victoria, 1861; 1907]. Drawn by E. J. Powell. At head of title: North America, west coast. Relief shown by bathymetry, soundings in feet, and hachures. Includes nautical features, streets, and footprints of significant buildings. First Nations reserves shown. First published 1861, updated and corrected. Latest date on map 1911. corr. 1907
